goal: Add hard-edged cartoon cel shading (one shadow tone per colour) to enoch-sheet-005-less-human's seed 246 image (marked on-track by Josh), keeping its paws, heads, symmetry, bold outlines, palette and plain white background.
why: Josh asked for shading in chat ("Lets add shading.", then "Yes shading" for this candidate). He is deliberately overriding the style guide's flat-colour rule; the rule and palette get updated with shadow tones if he calls this job on-track. Parent: art/jobs/enoch-sheet-005-less-human/out/enoch-sheet_231506246.png, which Josh marked on-track ('I think these are the best images so far') and which is a candidate. Base: job 005's prompt and negative, including its paw and fur chunk, so only the shading differs. (1) Prompt: 'flat color' and the old 'cel shading' are removed (flat-colour words fight shading), and '(cel shading:1.3), (simple shading:1.1)' goes early in the first chunk, right after the quality tags, where it carries most weight. 'cel shading' is the model's tag for hard-edged one-step shadow; 'simple shading' keeps it to a single shadow tone. 'thick outlines' stays. (2) Negative: adds '(painterly:1.2), (gradient:1.1), airbrush' to block soft or painted rendering, 'drop shadow' to keep shadows off the white background, and 'charcoal grey' to stop grey shadow tones on the fur. 'soft shading' and 'cast shadow' are deliberately NOT added. (3) Denoise 0.45 (job 005 used 0.7). Shading is a surface change: it needs to repaint fills with a darker tone but not redraw shapes. 0.45 should keep job 005's paws, heads, symmetry and tail while still letting Forge add shadow regions; 0.6 (job 1) redrew hands and faces too much, and below about 0.35 the shadows may not appear. Risk: too little shading shows at 0.45; the next job could raise it. (4) IP-Adapter weight 0.2, end 0.6 (was 0.4). The v14 reference is flat-coloured, so a strong reference would wash the shading out and pull the image back to flat colour. Two views: the previous reviewer (job 002) wanted to keep 0.4 so the job tests one change only; I chose 0.2 because the shading would be pulled away otherwise. Josh hasn't ruled on this. Everything else is as in job 005: img2img at the parent's size, Euler a, 30 steps, CFG 6, seeds 231506246-249, charsheet_lora_v1 at 0.6, symmetry tags, tail wording and jewelry negatives. Small job, 4 images, no hires, no masks, no guides, no pixel edits.
